name: hippo_gold_v1
description: Hippo Gold v1 benchmark: 210 domain-specific queries across 8 scenarios evaluating Top-3 recall, lifecycle filtering, identity isolation, and hard negative resistance.

corpus.text: Hippo uses Qdrant vector store running locally on port 6333 for dense memory persistence.
Python 3.12 is the primary execution runtime and language environment for Hippo core services.
Hippo strictly enforces package dependency management using Astral uv instead of Poetry or pip-tools.
Hippo documentation website is built with VitePress and package management is handled by pnpm.
The Spool queue in Hippo operates as a local append-only WAL directory at ~/.hippo/spool for asynchronous background ingestion.
The Spool worker daemon runs with concurrency=1 and bounded memory to prevent runaway resource consumption.
Memory consolidation is executed by HippoConsolidator to merge redundant facts into canonical summaries.
BM25 lexical scoring is fused with dense vector cosine similarity via reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) in the hybrid retrieval stage.
The search relevance gate applies a strict minimum threshold of 0.32 to filter out low-confidence memories.
Dense-only retrieval gate threshold is configured at 0.62 when sparse lexical signals are missing.
Hippo MCP server exposes only safe minimal tools: add_memory and search_memories.
The UntrustedContextEnvelope wraps all retrieved memory items before passing them to the agent to prevent prompt injection breakouts.
The spool retry governance mechanism automatically schedules exponential backoff for failed ingestion jobs.
Qdrant persistence directory for Hippo is located under ~/.hippo/storage/qdrant on local Unix systems.
Hippo uses fastembed with model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 as the default local embedding provider.
Git commit messages must strictly adhere to the Conventional Commits specification (e.g., feat(mcp): ...).
Direct pushes to the main branch are strictly forbidden; all changes require feature branches and pull requests.
Docs as Code rule: any code modification affecting architecture or interfaces must update documentation in the same PR.
Python linting and formatting are enforced via Ruff with select rules E9, F63, F7, and F82.
Running tests locally is done via uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
To build documentation locally, run pnpm docs:build from the repository root.
Feature branches must follow the naming pattern feat/<feature-name> or fix/<bug-name>.
Before starting implementation, an approved GitHub Issue must exist in the tracker.
GitHub issues use canonical 5-role taxonomy: needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, wontfix.
ADR documents reside in docs/adr/ and RFC documents reside in docs/rfcs/.

Hippo uses SQLite as the primary vector storage database on port 5432.
Hippo uses Qdrant standalone vector database on port 6333 after migration from SQLite.
The default embedding model for Hippo is text-embedding-ada-002 with 1536 dimensions.
The default local embedding model for Hippo is BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 with 384 dimensions.
The Spool worker daemon interval was configured to 60 seconds polling sleep.
The Spool worker daemon operates event-driven with 5 seconds wake-up frequency.
Python 3.10 was the minimum supported Python version during initial prototyping.
Python 3.12 is required and enforced as the minimum supported Python version.
Search results were unfiltered and directly returned the top 10 raw vector hits.
Search results must pass the Relevance Gate with max_injected=3 limit to prevent context pollution.
Documentation was originally generated with Sphinx and reStructuredText.
Documentation is generated with VitePress and standard Markdown.
Dependency management was initially handled with Poetry pyproject.toml.
Dependency management is exclusively handled with uv and uv.lock.
Hippo evaluation suite was temporarily using PyTest in early experiments.
Hippo uses Python built-in unittest framework discover runner for zero extra test dependencies.
Memory facts had no status flag and remained permanently queryable.
Memory facts have active or superseded status; superseded items are strictly filtered at lifecycle stage.
Hippo CLI command was named 'memory-mgr' in version 0.0.1.
Hippo CLI command is 'hippo' providing daemon, spool, and search subcommands.

Search pipeline Stage 1 retrieves raw candidate memories from Qdrant vector index and BM25 sparse index.
Search pipeline Stage 2 filters out memories that are superseded or do not match scope and user identity.
Search pipeline Stage 3 evaluates the Relevance Gate score thresholds to prune low-confidence candidates.
Search pipeline Stage 4 truncates the final accepted memory results to the configured max_injected limit (default 3).
Pitfall: When checking Qdrant collections in tests, never use production collection name 'memories' without 'eval_' prefix.
Pitfall: In evaluation trace, calculating nDCG when qrels is empty must return 1.0 only if retrieved list is also empty, else 0.0.
Pitfall: Calling _with_details gate functions directly in production hot path causes unnecessary memory tuple allocations.
Pitfall: VitePress build fails if markdown links reference non-existent anchor tags or outdated file paths.
Pitfall: Qdrant single-node container requires port 6333 for HTTP REST and port 6334 for internal gRPC.

Hippo evaluation runner generates twin JSON and Markdown summary reports with identical metric numbers.
Baseline comparison generates diff reports and exits with status code 2 if recall regresses or leakage occurs.
The minimum required nDCG calculation follows graded DCG formula with discounted logarithm base 2.
Hit Rate at k is defined as 1.0 if at least one relevant item appears in Top-k, otherwise 0.0.
Empty Accuracy measures the fraction of no-answer queries where the retrieval engine returned zero candidates.
Forbidden Leakage counts the number of prohibited memory items recalled in the Top-k results.
Hippo CLI doctor subcommand checks Qdrant health, embedding model availability, and spool directory status.
Hippo CLI daemon subcommand runs the background spool consumer with optional --run-once flag.
The search gate uses relative_threshold_ratio=0.50 to prune candidates that drop below half the best candidate score.
Evaluation temporary collections are named with prefix 'eval_bench_' followed by 12 random hex characters.
